text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Bournemouth and Manchester City at the Vitality Stadium!
The reverse fixture saw Bournemouth thrashed 6-1 by City, but that result was soon put behind them as they went on a seven-game unbeaten run afterwards.
However, that purple patch has faded since the new year, with the Cherries having failed to win any of their last six outings in the Premier League (D3 L3).
In all competitions though, they have only lost one of their last five matches (W1 D3), losing 3- away to Fulham.
City, on the other hand, are looking to close the gap to Liverpool at the top of the table back to one point with another win here.
The Citizens are currently on a 16-match unbeaten run in all competitions (W14 D2), extending that run with a 1-0 victory at home against Brentford on Tuesday.
They have history on their side in this fixture as well, having won all 13 of the previous Premier League games against Bournemouth.
Andoni Iraola makes just one change to the side that started the draw with Newcastle United last weekend.
Kerkez is brought in at left-back for Lloyd Kelly, who isn't included in the squad.
Faivre is among the substitutes after recovering from illness.
Pep Guardiola makes three changes from their win over Brentford in midweek, as Ake, Nunes and Kovacic all come into the side.
Walker, Alvarez and Bobb all drop to the bench, where De Bruyne and Grealish are also named after passing late fitness checks.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Christie gets the game under way for Bournemouth!
Bournemouth are pressing City high upfield early on here, and Tavernier almost forces Akanji into an early mistake.
The defender just manages to clear his lines in time though, and the visitors get themselves out of a tight spot.
City are knocking it around well in Bournemouth's half, but there isn't a lot of space for them to work in.
Foden and Haaland both try to spin away from their markers, only to turn straight into trouble.
Nunes makes a positive, driving run down the left, and he gets into the box before he loses steam.
He's easily nudged off the ball by Zabarnyi before he can put in a cross, and Bournemouth clear.
WIDE! Ake goals long and Foden flicks a wonderful pass into Haaland's feet on the edge of the D.
He gets the shot away early, but he doesn't catch it sweetly, sending it wide of the near post.
GOOD SAVE! Bournemouth go straight down the other end from the goal-kick, and Semenyo brings it down so he can lay it off to Kerkez.
It bounces up nicely in front of him and he puts his laces through it.
Ederson has to tip it over his crossbar.
Bournemouth have won none of their 19 league games against City (D2 L17), the most any side has ever faced another without winning in English Football League history.
City are almost caught out by another long ball from Bournemouth as Solanke sweeps it through, looking for Christie through the middle.
Ederson rushes out to collect it, only to hit his clearance straight against the midfielder, but he catches the ricochet.
Semenyo wins a free-kick on the right, and Christie swings a deep cross into the box.
Ederson rushes out to claim it once more, only to spill the ball, but no Bournemouth players are around him to profit.
Nunes makes another good run down the left and picks out a pullback to Rodri, who makes a late run into the box.
His first touch bounces away from him though, and Senesi hooks it away.
Silva finds himself in a tight spot in the corner, but he turns away from his marker long enough to pick out Foden on the edge of the box.
His first-time shot is tame, and Neto gets down to hold it.
Bournemouth have everybody back in their own half, and they're doing a good job of stifling City's attempted attacks.
The visitors are dominating possession, but aren't getting very far with it at the moment.
Tavernier cuts out Akanji's attempted throughball into Silva, and he goes long with a hopeful clearance out towards Solanke.
The forward is caught on his heels though, and Ederson comfortably collects.
FODEN SCORES! City's pressure finally pays off! It's a lovely scooped pass from Kovacic to Haaland, and Senesi is caught on the wrong side of the forward.
He fires his shot across goal, and Neto makes a good stop to keep him out but pushes it straight to Foden, who slots it into the back of the empty net.
1-0 City!
CHANCE! City are finding a lot of space out in the wide areas, and Silva slides it through for Stones, who pulls it back into a dangerous area.
Rodri's shot is blocked, and when it bounces to Silva, he curls his shot wide of the far post.
After a frantic couple of minutes on the back foot, Bournemouth are trying to impose themselves going forward once more, and Semenyo wins a free-kick on the right, but it comes to nothing.
Senesi spots Christie making another good run down the right, but his long ball is comfortably cut out by Ake.
City are back in possession, and they patiently play out from the back once more.
City have had 67 per cent possession so far in this game, but only adding to that here.
Eventually, Akanji makes a darting run down the right, but Kerkez stops him in his tracks.
Foden has now scored in each of his last four appearances against Bournemouth (four goals, two assists).
In two of the previous three games against the Cherries, he's both scored and assisted.
Bournemouth neatly play out from the back, but they're struggling to get over the halfway line at the moment.
They get it as far as Solanke this time, but he can't keep hold of it under pressure from Kovacic.
Stones is making a darting run into the box, and Cook is scrambling to get goalside of him.
He clips the City defender's heels in the process, and picks up the first booking of the game.
Foden steps up to take the free-kick and decides to go for goal himself.
He gets his shot up and over the wall, but it curls wide of the far top corner.
City break quickly on the counter, with Nunes sweeping it out to Silva on the right before continuing his run into the box.
The winger cuts inside and unexpectedly backheels it into Nunes' path.
He wasn't ready, and Zabarnyi clears it.
Nunes switches play out to Silva on the right from the free-kick, but he can't find any space for a cross.
He touches it back to Nunes, but his cross is comfortably cleared.
Christie flicks Senesi's pass into Tavernier's path, and he has a yard on Akanji as he drives down the left.
He plays an early cross into the box, but none of his team-mates are there, so Ederson collects.
The Bournemouth fans have made no secret of the fact that they think some refereeing decisions have gone against them, and they're off their seats again.
Semenyo goes down after a nudge from Akanji, but the referee waves him back to his feet.
GOOD SAVE! Cook threads it into Solanke, who holds off Dias long enough to cushion the ball into Christie's path.
He hits a good first-time shot on goal, and Ederson has to get down smartly to save it.
HALF-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 0-1 MANCHESTER CITY.
Foden's goal gives City a 1-0 lead over Bournemouth at the break.
The Citizens dominated from the first whistle, with Haaland missing an early chance by firing wide.
It was his shot that created the goal in the end, as his powerful effort was pushed straight to Foden's feet by Neto, and he turned it into the empty net.

events.action: turned it into the empty net

text: Foden came close again just before the break, with Ederson also making a good stop to deny Christie just moments later at the other end.
Despite only being 1-0 up, City look to be in total control of this game.
They've kept Bournemouth penned back with their possession and created some good chances, though Guardiola will want to see more of them finished off.
The Cherries aren't out of this tie yet though, and have still shown a threat on the break, while will have pleased Iraola.
City get us back under way for the second half!
Bournemouth work it neatly down their left, but Christie's throughball to Tavernier is poked away by Rodri.
Christie gets it back, but when he looks for Kerkez this time, he's drifted offside.
The Cherries have made a bright start to the second half, and they're putting City under pressure here.
Semenyo switches it out to the left once more, but Kerkez gets the cross all wrong as he lifts it straight out of play.
SAVE! Kerkez strays infield this time and squares it to Kluivert.
Dias is hesitant to close him down, so the Dutchman decides to have a shot from range instead, but Ederson gets down to hold it.
BLOCK! Haaland outmuscles Zabarnyi as he brings the ball under control and the defender ends up in the floor.
It works out best for him though, as he's in the right place to block the Norwegian's shot.
Foden just manages to keep the ball in play as he clips it to Silva on the far side of the box, and he curls another shot towards goal.
Senesi throws himself in front of it though, and City have another corner.
Bournemouth are committing a lot of bodies forward in attack, but it's leaving them vulnerable to a counter.
Nunes drives forward once more before trying to tee up Haaland, but he can't get it out of his feet.
City are being penned back in their own half at the moment, but they're keeping Bournemouth out of their box.
The hosts try to get crosses in from both flanks, but neither side is successful.
CHANCE! Solanke is picked out from a throw-in, and he does well to hold off Dias.
Since he can't get a sight of goal, he tees up Tavernier instead, but he drags his first-time shot wide of the far post.
City are finding their rhythm again now, and they're just patiently pushing Bournemouth backwards.
Rodri wants to go direct with a long ball, but none of his team-mates are offering that option.
City are making the first change of the game as they look to regain control.
Doku, who scored one and assisted four of the Citizen's six goals against Bournemouth in the reverse fixture, comes on for Nunes.
Doku's hard work down the left results in a City corner, and Foden swings it into the box.
He's got a crowd of team-mates at the far post, but it's cleared by Kluivert ahead of them.
GREAT SAVE! It's a great delivery from Christie on the corner, and Solanke gets away from his marker to thump a header on goal from the far post.
Ederson is behind his line when he punches it away, but the ball never fully crossed it.
Bournemouth are making a double change here in an attempt to build on their momentum.
Tavernier is the first to go off, with Ouattara on in his place.
And Kluivert is also making way, with Scott on in his place.
Senesi makes no attempt to play the ball as he grabs Haaland around the middle and drags him back.
He can have no complaints about that booking.
SAVE! Foden swings another deep corner into the box, and this time, Ake rises high to meet it at the far post.
He nods it down towards goal, but Neto holds onto it.
There's a nervy moment at the back for Ederson as he's quickly chased down by Solanke.
The forward almost stretches out a leg to nick it off him, but the goalkeeper checks back just in time to avoid him.
GREAT SAVE! Zabarnyi is sliding in to stop it from reaching Haaland, but he inadvertently helps it onto his toe.
The angle is against him on the left of the box, and Neto rushes out, making himself big to smother it.
That chance was Haaland's last involvement in the game as he's taken off and replaced by Alvarez.
Groans ring around the Vitality as Cook tries to thread it in behind City once more, but his team-mates are static.
None of them move to try and reach it, and Stones easily cuts it out.
Scott is closing in on Ake, but the defender does well to hold him off long enough to clear his lines.
Smith intercepts it, but luckily for City, his touch loops straight out of play.
Bournemouth's third change sees Senesi taken off and replaced by Faivre.
City's corner count continues to go up, but Alvarez, like Foden, is struggling to do something with them.
The Argentinian's cross is curled too close to Neto, who punches it away.
City's final roll of the dice sees De Bruyne brought on in place of Kovacic.
CLOSE! Ouattara slides in with a brilliant tackle on Rodri and plays a one-two with Christie.
It's a brilliant bit of play from the winger, who dribbles his way through a crowd in the box, but he drills his shot just wide of the far post at the end of it.
Silva clips the back of Semenyo's heels to stop the counter, and he goes into the referee's book.
Bournemouth's final change is a double one.
Christie, who has been at the heart of a lot of Bournemouth's attacking play, goes off for Unal.
And Kerkez is also taken off, with Sinisterra on in his place.
SO CLOSE! Bournemouth cut out another City attack, and break quickly on the counter.
Semenyo whips a great cross in from the right to pick out Unal at the far post, and he nods it towards the bottom corner.
It skims the post on its way wide, and that was the chance!
We're into six added minutes here, and City are back in possession to try to see this out.
They get out of their own half but are in no hurry to get it into the final third at the moment.
Bournemouth aren't going to give up just yet, and they surge forward on the counter once more.
Sinisterra has three to aim for in the box, but he slices at his cross, and it hits Dias.
De Bruyne is booked for time-wasting after delaying a Bournemouth throw-in.
FULL-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 0-1 MANCHESTER CITY.
City hold on to beat Bournemouth 1-0 and close the gap at the top of the table to one point.
The visitors dominated the first half and got their reward when Foden was on hand to turn the rebound of Haaland's saved shot into an empty net from close range.
Bournemouth came to life in the second half though, and Ederson made some great saves to deny Kluivert and Solanke before Neto smothered Haaland's shot at the other end.
Unal had the chance to equalise right at the end, but his header skimmed the outside of the post as it bounced wide.
It's a win that moves City within one point of Liverpool, and four clear of Arsenal, though the Gunners are kicking off shortly.
Next up for them is Luton Town in the FA Cup.
Bournemouth's winless run continues, and they've dropped to 14th.
They're also in FA Cup action next, as they host Leicester City.
That's all for today, goodbye!
